# Pyodide 0.27.7, vendored

The page runs Python in your browser with these files, served from this site. Nothing loads from another host at runtime.

Unchanged copies from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/`. Pyodide is under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide, tag 0.27.7). The NumPy wheel is under the BSD 3-Clause license, with its license file inside the wheel (source: https://github.com/numpy/numpy, tag v2.0.2). The wheel's hash also matches the one in `pyodide-lock.json`, and Pyodide checks that hash when it loads the wheel.
